note: Benchmark observations on fictional documents. Safe rejections and incomplete extractions are recorded here; none is an unsupported value accepted as validated.

observations.meaning: The model dropped the 'million' scale (1.6 instead of 1600000). The engine held it as Needs review. Had it been accepted, R1.6 against the R2,000,000 budget would have produced a false critical funding difference.
observations.consequence: The funding-vs-budget comparison was not exercised on live data. A controlled replay with only this value corrected exercised it and produced no funding finding.
observations.openIssue: Resolved as a requirement (R4.9, R7.6) and in the benchmark: a held critical field is a Needs-review finding (value.needs_review) and its dependent comparisons are recorded Not evaluated. The review interface and exports are Task 6.5.

observations.detail: Item values returned without their codes (CP-100, MS-20, PG-6). Supported by the cited evidence, so validated; differs from the label. Identical claims on a repeat of the RFQ, so this is stable. Recovered deterministically by the ScopeCheck identity step; the original claims, facts and scores are unchanged.

With packcheck.grant.v2 the live model returned funding_requested as amount 1600000 ZAR for the unchanged excerpt 'Funding requested: R1.6 million'. It validated. The other six claims were identical to the v1 run. Prompt tokens rose 490 -> 618 (longer field descriptions). The v1 failed extraction and the synthetic replay are retained.

The model did not extract the specification 'cast iron casing' on the CP-100 line. The pre-registered spec.differs finding for CP-100 is therefore missed. Recorded as Not evaluated in the comparison ledger ('no specification fact in quote-c'); strict scoring keeps it as a missed finding. Not an identity failure.

Exclusion returned as 'Installation and commissioning' (the cited evidence is the full sentence 'Installation and commissioning are excluded from this offer'). Supported by its evidence, so validated; differs from the label, which is unchanged.
One validated claim has no label: specification 'certified to SANS-1200' (cited evidence 'certified to SANS-1200'). Reported separately; neither counted correct nor incorrect.
